## Rules
- **emote is NOT a verb** — it's a field you add to ANY action above, for body language, facial expression, or a physical gesture toward yourself or someone else. Examples: {"action":"wait","emote":"offers an open hand for a high five"}, {"action":"go","target":"north","emote":"scratches the back of his head"}, {"action":"wait","emote":"winks at the woman"}, {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door","emote":"reaches for the key with a steady hand"}.
- Some items you spot give no useful information, and some are hidden from view — explore and examine to find them.
- Locked doors and items need the right item: use [item] on [target]. Your inventory is checked automatically — examine the target first to learn what it needs.
- If someone is shown by appearance rather than a real name, you haven't met them — judge them by what you see.
- "use" is for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, consumables). Use "use_on" only when the item must be used on something else.
- "put" needs a "relation": on, under, beside, behind, at, or in (e.g. put X in a container, put X on a table).
- "give"/"steal" need a target character who is in the same area as you.
- You can combine speech + volume + emote with ANY action in the same response.
- emote is body language — HOW you do something, or something you do to yourself or someone else (a kiss, a handshake, running a hand through your hair, reaching for the key). It shows the gesture and intention, never the outcome — the system resolves what actually happens. If you want the result of an action, take the action: reach for the key with an emote, but use "take" to actually pick it up. If you want to GRAB, PULL, or DRAG someone, use the "grab" action (they may resist with a save) — never narrate grabbing another character in your emote. If you are being held, use "escape" to break free.

=== ITEMS vs FLAVOR ===
The "The following items stand out to you:" list is everything you can interact with in the area. Items you carry or have equipped are always accessible. Area descriptions may mention things that are NOT separate items — if it's not in either list, you can't examine/take/use it separately. Use "inventory" to see what you're carrying, "look" for the full area view.

=== ACTION STRUCTURE ===
The "action" field is a single verb word (go, dash, crawl, climb, jump, take, drop, use, use_on, examine, open, close, attack, grab, escape, struggle, read, search, look, rest, wait, inventory, stats, relieve, ...). Put the thing you act on in the "item" and "target" fields — full multi-word names, never split.
Use "use" ALONE for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) — not "use_on".
If you wait, listen, or hold still, use "action": "wait".
Targets are matched leniently — by exact name, partial name, alias, or description words. Never truncate a name, but don't fret about getting it perfect; the system finds what you mean.

Examples:
- {"action":"use","item":"create flame"}                       → light a magical ember (use alone!)
- {"action":"use","item":"bread"}                              → eat food (use alone)
- {"action":"use","item":"healing salve"}                      → apply a self-use item
- {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"}
- {"action":"go","target":"north"}                             → by cardinal direction
- {"action":"go","target":"Door 4"}                            → by exit label
- {"action":"go","target":"Task 18 - Room 1"}                  → by the room it leads to
- {"action":"take","item":"Dried Flower Crown (Crushed)"}      → names are matched whole
- {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"}  → place on a surface
- {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"}        → hand to someone nearby

=== SPEECH & VOLUME ===
Put speech in the "speech" field and pick its volume in the "volume" field — whisper | say | shout | scream (default say). The volume word is the KEY name, never a value inside speech:
  WRONG: {"speech":"whisper psst, over here"}
  RIGHT: {"speech":"psst, over here","volume":"whisper"}
For a speech-only turn, omit "action" and provide speech + volume.
If you say nothing, OMIT the speech field entirely — never use empty strings.
To do nothing at all, respond {"action":"wait"} with no speech and no emote.

| go | Move to an exit | {"action":"go","target":"north"} |
| dash | Sprint through one exit — you'll immediately get a follow-up choice to chain a second move | {"action":"dash","target":"grand_stairs"} |
| crawl | Crawl through a tight/low passage (slow — go auto-crawls when you don't fit standing) | {"action":"crawl","target":"crawlspace"} |
| climb | Climb up/down a wall, rope, or ladder (risk of failing) | {"action":"climb","target":"well_rope"} |
| jump | Jump across a gap (risk of failing) | {"action":"jump","target":"broken_planks"} |
| open | Open a door/way | {"action":"open","target":"cellar_way"} |
| close | Close a door/way | {"action":"close","target":"cellar_way"} |
| take | Pick up an item | {"action":"take","item":"rusty_key"} |
| drop | Drop a carried item | {"action":"drop","item":"unlit_torch"} |
| use | Use a self-use item (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) | {"action":"use","item":"create flame"} |
| use_on | Use an item ON a target | {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"} |
| put / place | Put a carried item on/under/beside/behind/at/in a surface or container | {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"} |
| give | Hand a carried item to someone nearby | {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"} |
| steal | Take an item from someone nearby | {"action":"steal","item":"key","target":"Miki"} |
| examine | Learn more about an item, door, room, or person | {"action":"examine","target":"desk"} |
| read / search | Examine aliases | {"action":"read","target":"letters"} |
| wear / equip | Wear a carried item | {"action":"wear","item":"backpack"} |
| remove / unequip | Take off a worn item | {"action":"remove","item":"backpack"} |
| attack | Fight someone | {"action":"attack","target":"Miki"} |
| grab | Grab someone — drag them along when you move (they can resist) | {"action":"grab","target":"Jake Halloway"} |
| escape / struggle | Break free of a grapple (STR save) | {"action":"escape"} |
| rest | Rest to restore energy | {"action":"rest"} |
| wait | Do nothing — stand still and observe | {"action":"wait"} |
| inventory | Check what you carry | {"action":"inventory"} |
| stats | Check your condition | {"action":"stats"} |
| look | Re-read the room description | {"action":"look"} |
| fumble | Blind search in darkness | {"action":"fumble"} |
| relieve | Empty your bladder | {"action":"relieve"} |

## Rules
- **emote is NOT a verb** — it's a field you add to ANY action above, for body language, facial expression, or a physical gesture toward yourself or someone else. Examples: {"action":"wait","emote":"offers an open hand for a high five"}, {"action":"go","target":"north","emote":"scratches the back of his head"}, {"action":"wait","emote":"winks at the woman"}, {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door","emote":"reaches for the key with a steady hand"}.
- Some items you spot give no useful information, and some are hidden from view — explore and examine to find them.
- Locked doors and items need the right item: use [item] on [target]. Your inventory is checked automatically — examine the target first to learn what it needs.
- If someone is shown by appearance rather than a real name, you haven't met them — judge them by what you see.
- "use" is for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, consumables). Use "use_on" only when the item must be used on something else.
- "put" needs a "relation": on, under, beside, behind, at, or in (e.g. put X in a container, put X on a table).
- "give"/"steal" need a target character who is in the same area as you.
- You can combine speech + volume + emote with ANY action in the same response.
- emote is body language — HOW you do something, or something you do to yourself or someone else (a kiss, a handshake, running a hand through your hair, reaching for the key). It shows the gesture and intention, never the outcome — the system resolves what actually happens. If you want the result of an action, take the action: reach for the key with an emote, but use "take" to actually pick it up. If you want to GRAB, PULL, or DRAG someone, use the "grab" action (they may resist with a save) — never narrate grabbing another character in your emote. If you are being held, use "escape" to break free.

=== ITEMS vs FLAVOR ===
The "The following items stand out to you:" list is everything you can interact with in the area. Items you carry or have equipped are always accessible. Area descriptions may mention things that are NOT separate items — if it's not in either list, you can't examine/take/use it separately. Use "inventory" to see what you're carrying, "look" for the full area view.

=== ACTION STRUCTURE ===
The "action" field is a single verb word (go, dash, crawl, climb, jump, take, drop, use, use_on, examine, open, close, attack, grab, escape, struggle, read, search, look, rest, wait, inventory, stats, relieve, ...). Put the thing you act on in the "item" and "target" fields — full multi-word names, never split.
Use "use" ALONE for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) — not "use_on".
If you wait, listen, or hold still, use "action": "wait".
Targets are matched leniently — by exact name, partial name, alias, or description words. Never truncate a name, but don't fret about getting it perfect; the system finds what you mean.

Examples:
- {"action":"use","item":"create flame"}                       → light a magical ember (use alone!)
- {"action":"use","item":"bread"}                              → eat food (use alone)
- {"action":"use","item":"healing salve"}                      → apply a self-use item
- {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"}
- {"action":"go","target":"north"}                             → by cardinal direction
- {"action":"go","target":"Door 4"}                            → by exit label
- {"action":"go","target":"Task 18 - Room 1"}                  → by the room it leads to
- {"action":"take","item":"Dried Flower Crown (Crushed)"}      → names are matched whole
- {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"}  → place on a surface
- {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"}        → hand to someone nearby

=== SPEECH & VOLUME ===
Put speech in the "speech" field and pick its volume in the "volume" field — whisper | say | shout | scream (default say). The volume word is the KEY name, never a value inside speech:
  WRONG: {"speech":"whisper psst, over here"}
  RIGHT: {"speech":"psst, over here","volume":"whisper"}
For a speech-only turn, omit "action" and provide speech + volume.
If you say nothing, OMIT the speech field entirely — never use empty strings.
To do nothing at all, respond {"action":"wait"} with no speech and no emote.

=== ACTIONS ===

| Verb | What it does | Example |
|---|---|---|

| dash | Sprint through one exit — you'll immediately get a follow-up choice to chain a second move | {"action":"dash","target":"grand_stairs"} |

| climb | Climb up/down a wall, rope, or ladder (risk of failing) | {"action":"climb","target":"well_rope"} |

| take | Pick up an item | {"action":"take","item":"rusty_key"} |
| drop | Drop a carried item | {"action":"drop","item":"unlit_torch"} |
| use | Use a self-use item (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) | {"action":"use","item":"create flame"} |
| use_on | Use an item ON a target | {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"} |
| put / place | Put a carried item on/under/beside/behind/at/in a surface or container | {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"} |
| give | Hand a carried item to someone nearby | {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"} |

## Rules
- **emote is NOT a verb** — it's a field you add to ANY action above, for body language, facial expression, or a physical gesture toward yourself or someone else. Examples: {"action":"wait","emote":"offers an open hand for a high five"}, {"action":"go","target":"north","emote":"scratches the back of his head"}, {"action":"wait","emote":"winks at the woman"}, {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door","emote":"reaches for the key with a steady hand"}.
- Some items you spot give no useful information, and some are hidden from view — explore and examine to find them.
- Locked doors and items need the right item: use [item] on [target]. Your inventory is checked automatically — examine the target first to learn what it needs.
- If someone is shown by appearance rather than a real name, you haven't met them — judge them by what you see.
- "use" is for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, consumables). Use "use_on" only when the item must be used on something else.
- "put" needs a "relation": on, under, beside, behind, at, or in (e.g. put X in a container, put X on a table).
- "give"/"steal" need a target character who is in the same area as you.
- You can combine speech + volume + emote with ANY action in the same response.
- emote is body language — HOW you do something, or something you do to yourself or someone else (a kiss, a handshake, running a hand through your hair, reaching for the key). It shows the gesture and intention, never the outcome — the system resolves what actually happens. If you want the result of an action, take the action: reach for the key with an emote, but use "take" to actually pick it up. If you want to GRAB, PULL, or DRAG someone, use the "grab" action (they may resist with a save) — never narrate grabbing another character in your emote. If you are being held, use "escape" to break free.

=== ITEMS vs FLAVOR ===
The "The following items stand out to you:" list is everything you can interact with in the area. Items you carry or have equipped are always accessible. Area descriptions may mention things that are NOT separate items — if it's not in either list, you can't examine/take/use it separately. Use "inventory" to see what you're carrying, "look" for the full area view.

=== ACTION STRUCTURE ===
The "action" field is a single verb word (go, dash, crawl, climb, jump, take, drop, use, use_on, examine, open, close, attack, grab, escape, struggle, read, search, look, rest, wait, inventory, stats, relieve, ...). Put the thing you act on in the "item" and "target" fields — full multi-word names, never split.
Use "use" ALONE for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) — not "use_on".
If you wait, listen, or hold still, use "action": "wait".
Targets are matched leniently — by exact name, partial name, alias, or description words. Never truncate a name, but don't fret about getting it perfect; the system finds what you mean.

Examples:
- {"action":"use","item":"create flame"}                       → light a magical ember (use alone!)
- {"action":"use","item":"bread"}                              → eat food (use alone)
- {"action":"use","item":"healing salve"}                      → apply a self-use item
- {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"}
- {"action":"go","target":"north"}                             → by cardinal direction
- {"action":"go","target":"Door 4"}                            → by exit label
- {"action":"go","target":"Task 18 - Room 1"}                  → by the room it leads to
- {"action":"take","item":"Dried Flower Crown (Crushed)"}      → names are matched whole
- {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"}  → place on a surface
- {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"}        → hand to someone nearby

=== SPEECH & VOLUME ===
Put speech in the "speech" field and pick its volume in the "volume" field — whisper | say | shout | scream (default say). The volume word is the KEY name, never a value inside speech:
  WRONG: {"speech":"whisper psst, over here"}
  RIGHT: {"speech":"psst, over here","volume":"whisper"}
For a speech-only turn, omit "action" and provide speech + volume.
If you say nothing, OMIT the speech field entirely — never use empty strings.
To do nothing at all, respond {"action":"wait"} with no speech and no emote.

=== ACTIONS ===

| Verb | What it does | Example |
|---|---|---|
| go | Move to an exit | {"action":"go","target":"north"} |
| dash | Sprint through one exit — you'll immediately get a follow-up choice to chain a second move | {"action":"dash","target":"grand_stairs"} |
| crawl | Crawl through a tight/low passage (slow — go auto-crawls when you don't fit standing) | {"action":"crawl","target":"crawlspace"} |
| climb | Climb up/down a wall, rope, or ladder (risk of failing) | {"action":"climb","target":"well_rope"} |
| jump | Jump across a gap (risk of failing) | {"action":"jump","target":"broken_planks"} |
| open | Open a door/way | {"action":"open","target":"cellar_way"} |
| close | Close a door/way | {"action":"close","target":"cellar_way"} |
| take | Pick up an item | {"action":"take","item":"rusty_key"} |
| drop | Drop a carried item | {"action":"drop","item":"unlit_torch"} |
| use | Use a self-use item (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) | {"action":"use","item":"create flame"} |
| use_on | Use an item ON a target | {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"} |
| put / place | Put a carried item on/under/beside/behind/at/in a surface or container | {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"} |
| give | Hand a carried item to someone nearby | {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"} |
| steal | Take an item from someone nearby | {"action":"steal","item":"key","target":"Miki"} |
| examine | Learn more about an item, door, room, or person | {"action":"examine","target":"desk"} |
| read / search | Examine aliases | {"action":"read","target":"letters"} |
| wear / equip | Wear a carried item | {"action":"wear","item":"backpack"} |
| remove / unequip | Take off a worn item | {"action":"remove","item":"backpack"} |
| attack | Fight someone | {"action":"attack","target":"Miki"} |
| grab | Grab someone — drag them along when you move (they can resist) | {"action":"grab","target":"Jake Halloway"} |
| escape / struggle | Break free of a grapple (STR save) | {"action":"escape"} |
| rest | Rest to restore energy | {"action":"rest"} |
| wait | Do nothing — stand still and observe | {"action":"wait"} |
| inventory | Check what you carry | {"action":"inventory"} |
| stats | Check your condition | {"action":"stats"} |
| look | Re-read the room description | {"action":"look"} |
| fumble | Blind search in darkness | {"action":"fumble"} |
| relieve | Empty your bladder | {"action":"relieve"} |

## Rules
- **emote is NOT a verb** — it's a field you add to ANY action above, for body language, facial expression, or a physical gesture toward yourself or someone else. Examples: {"action":"wait","emote":"offers an open hand for a high five"}, {"action":"go","target":"north","emote":"scratches the back of his head"}, {"action":"wait","emote":"winks at the woman"}, {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door","emote":"reaches for the key with a steady hand"}.
- Some items you spot give no useful information, and some are hidden from view — explore and examine to find them.
- Locked doors and items need the right item: use [item] on [target]. Your inventory is checked automatically — examine the target first to learn what it needs.
- If someone is shown by appearance rather than a real name, you haven't met them — judge them by what you see.
- "use" is for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, consumables). Use "use_on" only when the item must be used on something else.
- "put" needs a "relation": on, under, beside, behind, at, or in (e.g. put X in a container, put X on a table).
- "give"/"steal" need a target character who is in the same area as you.
- You can combine speech + volume + emote with ANY action in the same response.
- emote is body language — HOW you do something, or something you do to yourself or someone else (a kiss, a handshake, running a hand through your hair, reaching for the key). It shows the gesture and intention, never the outcome — the system resolves what actually happens. If you want the result of an action, take the action: reach for the key with an emote, but use "take" to actually pick it up. If you want to GRAB, PULL, or DRAG someone, use the "grab" action (they may resist with a save) — never narrate grabbing another character in your emote. If you are being held, use "escape" to break free.

=== ITEMS vs FLAVOR ===
The "The following items stand out to you:" list is everything you can interact with in the area. Items you carry or have equipped are always accessible. Area descriptions may mention things that are NOT separate items — if it's not in either list, you can't examine/take/use it separately. Use "inventory" to see what you're carrying, "look" for the full area view.

=== ACTION STRUCTURE ===
The "action" field is a single verb word (go, dash, crawl, climb, jump, take, drop, use, use_on, examine, open, close, attack, grab, escape, struggle, read, search, look, rest, wait, inventory, stats, relieve, ...). Put the thing you act on in the "item" and "target" fields — full multi-word names, never split.
Use "use" ALONE for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) — not "use_on".
If you wait, listen, or hold still, use "action": "wait".
Targets are matched leniently — by exact name, partial name, alias, or description words. Never truncate a name, but don't fret about getting it perfect; the system finds what you mean.

Examples:
- {"action":"use","item":"create flame"}                       → light a magical ember (use alone!)
- {"action":"use","item":"bread"}                              → eat food (use alone)
- {"action":"use","item":"healing salve"}                      → apply a self-use item
- {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"}
- {"action":"go","target":"north"}                             → by cardinal direction
- {"action":"go","target":"Door 4"}                            → by exit label
- {"action":"go","target":"Task 18 - Room 1"}                  → by the room it leads to
- {"action":"take","item":"Dried Flower Crown (Crushed)"}      → names are matched whole
- {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"}  → place on a surface
- {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"}        → hand to someone nearby

=== SPEECH & VOLUME ===
Put speech in the "speech" field and pick its volume in the "volume" field — whisper | say | shout | scream (default say). The volume word is the KEY name, never a value inside speech:
  WRONG: {"speech":"whisper psst, over here"}
  RIGHT: {"speech":"psst, over here","volume":"whisper"}
For a speech-only turn, omit "action" and provide speech + volume.
If you say nothing, OMIT the speech field entirely — never use empty strings.
To do nothing at all, respond {"action":"wait"} with no speech and no emote.

| give | Hand a carried item to someone nearby | {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"} |
| steal | Take an item from someone nearby | {"action":"steal","item":"key","target":"Miki"} |
| examine | Learn more about an item, door, room, or person | {"action":"examine","target":"desk"} |
| read / search | Examine aliases | {"action":"read","target":"letters"} |
| wear / equip | Wear a carried item | {"action":"wear","item":"backpack"} |
| remove / unequip | Take off a worn item | {"action":"remove","item":"backpack"} |
| attack | Fight someone | {"action":"attack","target":"Miki"} |
| grab | Grab someone — drag them along when you move (they can resist) | {"action":"grab","target":"Jake Halloway"} |
| escape / struggle | Break free of a grapple (STR save) | {"action":"escape"} |
| rest | Rest to restore energy | {"action":"rest"} |
| wait | Do nothing — stand still and observe | {"action":"wait"} |
| inventory | Check what you carry | {"action":"inventory"} |
| stats | Check your condition | {"action":"stats"} |
| look | Re-read the room description | {"action":"look"} |
| fumble | Blind search in darkness | {"action":"fumble"} |
| relieve | Empty your bladder | {"action":"relieve"} |

## Rules
- **emote is NOT a verb** — it's a field you add to ANY action above, for body language, facial expression, or a physical gesture toward yourself or someone else. Examples: {"action":"wait","emote":"offers an open hand for a high five"}, {"action":"go","target":"north","emote":"scratches the back of his head"}, {"action":"wait","emote":"winks at the woman"}, {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door","emote":"reaches for the key with a steady hand"}.
- Some items you spot give no useful information, and some are hidden from view — explore and examine to find them.
- Locked doors and items need the right item: use [item] on [target]. Your inventory is checked automatically — examine the target first to learn what it needs.
- If someone is shown by appearance rather than a real name, you haven't met them — judge them by what you see.
- "use" is for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, consumables). Use "use_on" only when the item must be used on something else.
- "put" needs a "relation": on, under, beside, behind, at, or in (e.g. put X in a container, put X on a table).
- "give"/"steal" need a target character who is in the same area as you.
- You can combine speech + volume + emote with ANY action in the same response.
- emote is body language — HOW you do something, or something you do to yourself or someone else (a kiss, a handshake, running a hand through your hair, reaching for the key). It shows the gesture and intention, never the outcome — the system resolves what actually happens. If you want the result of an action, take the action: reach for the key with an emote, but use "take" to actually pick it up. If you want to GRAB, PULL, or DRAG someone, use the "grab" action (they may resist with a save) — never narrate grabbing another character in your emote. If you are being held, use "escape" to break free.

=== ITEMS vs FLAVOR ===
The "The following items stand out to you:" list is everything you can interact with in the area. Items you carry or have equipped are always accessible. Area descriptions may mention things that are NOT separate items — if it's not in either list, you can't examine/take/use it separately. Use "inventory" to see what you're carrying, "look" for the full area view.

=== ACTION STRUCTURE ===
The "action" field is a single verb word (go, dash, crawl, climb, jump, take, drop, use, use_on, examine, open, close, attack, grab, escape, struggle, read, search, look, rest, wait, inventory, stats, relieve, ...). Put the thing you act on in the "item" and "target" fields — full multi-word names, never split.
Use "use" ALONE for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) — not "use_on".
If you wait, listen, or hold still, use "action": "wait".
Targets are matched leniently — by exact name, partial name, alias, or description words. Never truncate a name, but don't fret about getting it perfect; the system finds what you mean.

Examples:
- {"action":"use","item":"create flame"}                       → light a magical ember (use alone!)
- {"action":"use","item":"bread"}                              → eat food (use alone)
- {"action":"use","item":"healing salve"}                      → apply a self-use item
- {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"}
- {"action":"go","target":"north"}                             → by cardinal direction
- {"action":"go","target":"Door 4"}                            → by exit label
- {"action":"go","target":"Task 18 - Room 1"}                  → by the room it leads to
- {"action":"take","item":"Dried Flower Crown (Crushed)"}      → names are matched whole
- {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"}  → place on a surface
- {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"}        → hand to someone nearby

=== SPEECH & VOLUME ===
Put speech in the "speech" field and pick its volume in the "volume" field — whisper | say | shout | scream (default say). The volume word is the KEY name, never a value inside speech:
  WRONG: {"speech":"whisper psst, over here"}
  RIGHT: {"speech":"psst, over here","volume":"whisper"}
For a speech-only turn, omit "action" and provide speech + volume.
If you say nothing, OMIT the speech field entirely — never use empty strings.
To do nothing at all, respond {"action":"wait"} with no speech and no emote.

=== ACTIONS ===
Emit ONE action per response as a structured object. The verb goes in "action"; the thing you act on goes in "item"/"target" — always the FULL multi-word name, never truncated.

| Verb | What it does | Example |
|---|---|---|
| go | Move to an exit | {"action":"go","target":"north"} |
| dash | Sprint through one exit — you'll immediately get a follow-up choice to chain a second move | {"action":"dash","target":"grand_stairs"} |
| crawl | Crawl through a tight/low passage (slow — go auto-crawls when you don't fit standing) | {"action":"crawl","target":"crawlspace"} |
| climb | Climb up/down a wall, rope, or ladder (risk of failing) | {"action":"climb","target":"well_rope"} |
| jump | Jump across a gap (risk of failing) | {"action":"jump","target":"broken_planks"} |
| open | Open a door/way | {"action":"open","target":"cellar_way"} |
| close | Close a door/way | {"action":"close","target":"cellar_way"} |
| take | Pick up an item | {"action":"take","item":"rusty_key"} |
| drop | Drop a carried item | {"action":"drop","item":"unlit_torch"} |
| use | Use a self-use item (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) | {"action":"use","item":"create flame"} |
| use_on | Use an item ON a target | {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"} |
| put / place | Put a carried item on/under/beside/behind/at/in a surface or container | {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"} |
| give | Hand a carried item to someone nearby | {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"} |
| steal | Take an item from someone nearby | {"action":"steal","item":"key","target":"Miki"} |
| examine | Learn more about an item, door, room, or person | {"action":"examine","target":"desk"} |
| read / search | Examine aliases | {"action":"read","target":"letters"} |
| wear / equip | Wear a carried item | {"action":"wear","item":"backpack"} |
| remove / unequip | Take off a worn item | {"action":"remove","item":"backpack"} |
| attack | Fight someone | {"action":"attack","target":"Miki"} |
| grab | Grab someone — drag them along when you move (they can resist) | {"action":"grab","target":"Jake Halloway"} |
| escape / struggle | Break free of a grapple (STR save) | {"action":"escape"} |
| rest | Rest to restore energy | {"action":"rest"} |
| wait | Do nothing — stand still and observe | {"action":"wait"} |
| inventory | Check what you carry | {"action":"inventory"} |
| stats | Check your condition | {"action":"stats"} |
| look | Re-read the room description | {"action":"look"} |
| fumble | Blind search in darkness | {"action":"fumble"} |
| relieve | Empty your bladder | {"action":"relieve"} |

## Rules
- **emote is NOT a verb** — it's a field you add to ANY action above, for body language, facial expression, or a physical gesture toward yourself or someone else. Examples: {"action":"wait","emote":"offers an open hand for a high five"}, {"action":"go","target":"north","emote":"scratches the back of his head"}, {"action":"wait","emote":"winks at the woman"}, {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door","emote":"reaches for the key with a steady hand"}.
- Some items you spot give no useful information, and some are hidden from view — explore and examine to find them.
- Locked doors and items need the right item: use [item] on [target]. Your inventory is checked automatically — examine the target first to learn what it needs.
- If someone is shown by appearance rather than a real name, you haven't met them — judge them by what you see.
- "use" is for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, consumables). Use "use_on" only when the item must be used on something else.
- "put" needs a "relation": on, under, beside, behind, at, or in (e.g. put X in a container, put X on a table).
- "give"/"steal" need a target character who is in the same area as you.
- You can combine speech + volume + emote with ANY action in the same response.
- emote is body language — HOW you do something, or something you do to yourself or someone else (a kiss, a handshake, running a hand through your hair, reaching for the key). It shows the gesture and intention, never the outcome — the system resolves what actually happens. If you want the result of an action, take the action: reach for the key with an emote, but use "take" to actually pick it up. If you want to GRAB, PULL, or DRAG someone, use the "grab" action (they may resist with a save) — never narrate grabbing another character in your emote. If you are being held, use "escape" to break free.

=== ITEMS vs FLAVOR ===
The "The following items stand out to you:" list is everything you can interact with in the area. Items you carry or have equipped are always accessible. Area descriptions may mention things that are NOT separate items — if it's not in either list, you can't examine/take/use it separately. Use "inventory" to see what you're carrying, "look" for the full area view.

=== ACTION STRUCTURE ===
The "action" field is a single verb word (go, dash, crawl, climb, jump, take, drop, use, use_on, examine, open, close, attack, grab, escape, struggle, read, search, look, rest, wait, inventory, stats, relieve, ...). Put the thing you act on in the "item" and "target" fields — full multi-word names, never split.
Use "use" ALONE for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) — not "use_on".
If you wait, listen, or hold still, use "action": "wait".
Targets are matched leniently — by exact name, partial name, alias, or description words. Never truncate a name, but don't fret about getting it perfect; the system finds what you mean.

Examples:
- {"action":"use","item":"create flame"}                       → light a magical ember (use alone!)
- {"action":"use","item":"bread"}                              → eat food (use alone)
- {"action":"use","item":"healing salve"}                      → apply a self-use item
- {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"}
- {"action":"go","target":"north"}                             → by cardinal direction
- {"action":"go","target":"Door 4"}                            → by exit label
- {"action":"go","target":"Task 18 - Room 1"}                  → by the room it leads to
- {"action":"take","item":"Dried Flower Crown (Crushed)"}      → names are matched whole
- {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"}  → place on a surface
- {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"}        → hand to someone nearby

=== SPEECH & VOLUME ===
Put speech in the "speech" field and pick its volume in the "volume" field — whisper | say | shout | scream (default say). The volume word is the KEY name, never a value inside speech:
  WRONG: {"speech":"whisper psst, over here"}
  RIGHT: {"speech":"psst, over here","volume":"whisper"}
For a speech-only turn, omit "action" and provide speech + volume.
If you say nothing, OMIT the speech field entirely — never use empty strings.
To do nothing at all, respond {"action":"wait"} with no speech and no emote.

## Rules
- **emote is NOT a verb** — it's a field you add to ANY action above, for body language, facial expression, or a physical gesture toward yourself or someone else. Examples: {"action":"wait","emote":"offers an open hand for a high five"}, {"action":"go","target":"north","emote":"scratches the back of his head"}, {"action":"wait","emote":"winks at the woman"}, {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door","emote":"reaches for the key with a steady hand"}.
- Some items you spot give no useful information, and some are hidden from view — explore and examine to find them.
- Locked doors and items need the right item: use [item] on [target]. Your inventory is checked automatically — examine the target first to learn what it needs.
- If someone is shown by appearance rather than a real name, you haven't met them — judge them by what you see.
- "use" is for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, consumables). Use "use_on" only when the item must be used on something else.
- "put" needs a "relation": on, under, beside, behind, at, or in (e.g. put X in a container, put X on a table).
- "give"/"steal" need a target character who is in the same area as you.
- You can combine speech + volume + emote with ANY action in the same response.
- emote is body language — HOW you do something, or something you do to yourself or someone else (a kiss, a handshake, running a hand through your hair, reaching for the key). It shows the gesture and intention, never the outcome — the system resolves what actually happens. If you want the result of an action, take the action: reach for the key with an emote, but use "take" to actually pick it up. If you want to GRAB, PULL, or DRAG someone, use the "grab" action (they may resist with a save) — never narrate grabbing another character in your emote. If you are being held, use "escape" to break free.

=== ITEMS vs FLAVOR ===
The "The following items stand out to you:" list is everything you can interact with in the area. Items you carry or have equipped are always accessible. Area descriptions may mention things that are NOT separate items — if it's not in either list, you can't examine/take/use it separately. Use "inventory" to see what you're carrying, "look" for the full area view.

=== ACTION STRUCTURE ===
The "action" field is a single verb word (go, dash, crawl, climb, jump, take, drop, use, use_on, examine, open, close, attack, grab, escape, struggle, read, search, look, rest, wait, inventory, stats, relieve, ...). Put the thing you act on in the "item" and "target" fields — full multi-word names, never split.
Use "use" ALONE for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) — not "use_on".
If you wait, listen, or hold still, use "action": "wait".
Targets are matched leniently — by exact name, partial name, alias, or description words. Never truncate a name, but don't fret about getting it perfect; the system finds what you mean.

Examples:
- {"action":"use","item":"create flame"}                       → light a magical ember (use alone!)
- {"action":"use","item":"bread"}                              → eat food (use alone)
- {"action":"use","item":"healing salve"}                      → apply a self-use item
- {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"}
- {"action":"go","target":"north"}                             → by cardinal direction
- {"action":"go","target":"Door 4"}                            → by exit label
- {"action":"go","target":"Task 18 - Room 1"}                  → by the room it leads to
- {"action":"take","item":"Dried Flower Crown (Crushed)"}      → names are matched whole
- {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"}  → place on a surface
- {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"}        → hand to someone nearby

=== SPEECH & VOLUME ===
Put speech in the "speech" field and pick its volume in the "volume" field — whisper | say | shout | scream (default say). The volume word is the KEY name, never a value inside speech:
  WRONG: {"speech":"whisper psst, over here"}
  RIGHT: {"speech":"psst, over here","volume":"whisper"}
For a speech-only turn, omit "action" and provide speech + volume.
If you say nothing, OMIT the speech field entirely — never use empty strings.
To do nothing at all, respond {"action":"wait"} with no speech and no emote.

| drop | Drop a carried item | {"action":"drop","item":"unlit_torch"} |

| use_on | Use an item ON a target | {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"} |
| put / place | Put a carried item on/under/beside/behind/at/in a surface or container | {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"} |
| give | Hand a carried item to someone nearby | {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"} |
| steal | Take an item from someone nearby | {"action":"steal","item":"key","target":"Miki"} |
| examine | Learn more about an item, door, room, or person | {"action":"examine","target":"desk"} |
| read / search | Examine aliases | {"action":"read","target":"letters"} |
| wear / equip | Wear a carried item | {"action":"wear","item":"backpack"} |
| remove / unequip | Take off a worn item | {"action":"remove","item":"backpack"} |
| attack | Fight someone | {"action":"attack","target":"Miki"} |
| grab | Grab someone — drag them along when you move (they can resist) | {"action":"grab","target":"Jake Halloway"} |
| escape / struggle | Break free of a grapple (STR save) | {"action":"escape"} |
| rest | Rest to restore energy | {"action":"rest"} |
| wait | Do nothing — stand still and observe | {"action":"wait"} |
| inventory | Check what you carry | {"action":"inventory"} |
| stats | Check your condition | {"action":"stats"} |
| look | Re-read the room description | {"action":"look"} |
| fumble | Blind search in darkness | {"action":"fumble"} |
| relieve | Empty your bladder | {"action":"relieve"} |

## Rules
- **emote is NOT a verb** — it's a field you add to ANY action above, for body language, facial expression, or a physical gesture toward yourself or someone else. Examples: {"action":"wait","emote":"offers an open hand for a high five"}, {"action":"go","target":"north","emote":"scratches the back of his head"}, {"action":"wait","emote":"winks at the woman"}, {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door","emote":"reaches for the key with a steady hand"}.
- Some items you spot give no useful information, and some are hidden from view — explore and examine to find them.
- Locked doors and items need the right item: use [item] on [target]. Your inventory is checked automatically — examine the target first to learn what it needs.
- If someone is shown by appearance rather than a real name, you haven't met them — judge them by what you see.
- "use" is for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, consumables). Use "use_on" only when the item must be used on something else.
- "put" needs a "relation": on, under, beside, behind, at, or in (e.g. put X in a container, put X on a table).
- "give"/"steal" need a target character who is in the same area as you.
- You can combine speech + volume + emote with ANY action in the same response.
- emote is body language — HOW you do something, or something you do to yourself or someone else (a kiss, a handshake, running a hand through your hair, reaching for the key). It shows the gesture and intention, never the outcome — the system resolves what actually happens. If you want the result of an action, take the action: reach for the key with an emote, but use "take" to actually pick it up. If you want to GRAB, PULL, or DRAG someone, use the "grab" action (they may resist with a save) — never narrate grabbing another character in your emote. If you are being held, use "escape" to break free.

=== ITEMS vs FLAVOR ===
The "The following items stand out to you:" list is everything you can interact with in the area. Items you carry or have equipped are always accessible. Area descriptions may mention things that are NOT separate items — if it's not in either list, you can't examine/take/use it separately. Use "inventory" to see what you're carrying, "look" for the full area view.

=== ACTION STRUCTURE ===
The "action" field is a single verb word (go, dash, crawl, climb, jump, take, drop, use, use_on, examine, open, close, attack, grab, escape, struggle, read, search, look, rest, wait, inventory, stats, relieve, ...). Put the thing you act on in the "item" and "target" fields — full multi-word names, never split.
Use "use" ALONE for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) — not "use_on".
If you wait, listen, or hold still, use "action": "wait".
Targets are matched leniently — by exact name, partial name, alias, or description words. Never truncate a name, but don't fret about getting it perfect; the system finds what you mean.

Examples:
- {"action":"use","item":"create flame"}                       → light a magical ember (use alone!)
- {"action":"use","item":"bread"}                              → eat food (use alone)
- {"action":"use","item":"healing salve"}                      → apply a self-use item
- {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"}
- {"action":"go","target":"north"}                             → by cardinal direction
- {"action":"go","target":"Door 4"}                            → by exit label
- {"action":"go","target":"Task 18 - Room 1"}                  → by the room it leads to
- {"action":"take","item":"Dried Flower Crown (Crushed)"}      → names are matched whole
- {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"}  → place on a surface
- {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"}        → hand to someone nearby

=== SPEECH & VOLUME ===
Put speech in the "speech" field and pick its volume in the "volume" field — whisper | say | shout | scream (default say). The volume word is the KEY name, never a value inside speech:
  WRONG: {"speech":"whisper psst, over here"}
  RIGHT: {"speech":"psst, over here","volume":"whisper"}
For a speech-only turn, omit "action" and provide speech + volume.
If you say nothing, OMIT the speech field entirely — never use empty strings.
To do nothing at all, respond {"action":"wait"} with no speech and no emote.

=== ACTIONS ===

| Verb | What it does | Example |
|---|---|---|

| dash | Sprint through one exit — you'll immediately get a follow-up choice to chain a second move | {"action":"dash","target":"grand_stairs"} |
| crawl | Crawl through a tight/low passage (slow — go auto-crawls when you don't fit standing) | {"action":"crawl","target":"crawlspace"} |
| climb | Climb up/down a wall, rope, or ladder (risk of failing) | {"action":"climb","target":"well_rope"} |

| open | Open a door/way | {"action":"open","target":"cellar_way"} |
| close | Close a door/way | {"action":"close","target":"cellar_way"} |
| take | Pick up an item | {"action":"take","item":"rusty_key"} |
| drop | Drop a carried item | {"action":"drop","item":"unlit_torch"} |
| use | Use a self-use item (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) | {"action":"use","item":"create flame"} |
| use_on | Use an item ON a target | {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"} |
| put / place | Put a carried item on/under/beside/behind/at/in a surface or container | {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"} |
| give | Hand a carried item to someone nearby | {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"} |

## Rules
- **emote is NOT a verb** — it's a field you add to ANY action above, for body language, facial expression, or a physical gesture toward yourself or someone else. Examples: {"action":"wait","emote":"offers an open hand for a high five"}, {"action":"go","target":"north","emote":"scratches the back of his head"}, {"action":"wait","emote":"winks at the woman"}, {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door","emote":"reaches for the key with a steady hand"}.
- Some items you spot give no useful information, and some are hidden from view — explore and examine to find them.
- Locked doors and items need the right item: use [item] on [target]. Your inventory is checked automatically — examine the target first to learn what it needs.
- If someone is shown by appearance rather than a real name, you haven't met them — judge them by what you see.
- "use" is for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, consumables). Use "use_on" only when the item must be used on something else.
- "put" needs a "relation": on, under, beside, behind, at, or in (e.g. put X in a container, put X on a table).
- "give"/"steal" need a target character who is in the same area as you.
- You can combine speech + volume + emote with ANY action in the same response.
- emote is body language — HOW you do something, or something you do to yourself or someone else (a kiss, a handshake, running a hand through your hair, reaching for the key). It shows the gesture and intention, never the outcome — the system resolves what actually happens. If you want the result of an action, take the action: reach for the key with an emote, but use "take" to actually pick it up. If you want to GRAB, PULL, or DRAG someone, use the "grab" action (they may resist with a save) — never narrate grabbing another character in your emote. If you are being held, use "escape" to break free.

=== ITEMS vs FLAVOR ===
The "The following items stand out to you:" list is everything you can interact with in the area. Items you carry or have equipped are always accessible. Area descriptions may mention things that are NOT separate items — if it's not in either list, you can't examine/take/use it separately. Use "inventory" to see what you're carrying, "look" for the full area view.

=== ACTION STRUCTURE ===
The "action" field is a single verb word (go, dash, crawl, climb, jump, take, drop, use, use_on, examine, open, close, attack, grab, escape, struggle, read, search, look, rest, wait, inventory, stats, relieve, ...). Put the thing you act on in the "item" and "target" fields — full multi-word names, never split.
Use "use" ALONE for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) — not "use_on".
If you wait, listen, or hold still, use "action": "wait".
Targets are matched leniently — by exact name, partial name, alias, or description words. Never truncate a name, but don't fret about getting it perfect; the system finds what you mean.

Examples:
- {"action":"use","item":"create flame"}                       → light a magical ember (use alone!)
- {"action":"use","item":"bread"}                              → eat food (use alone)
- {"action":"use","item":"healing salve"}                      → apply a self-use item
- {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"}
- {"action":"go","target":"north"}                             → by cardinal direction
- {"action":"go","target":"Door 4"}                            → by exit label
- {"action":"go","target":"Task 18 - Room 1"}                  → by the room it leads to
- {"action":"take","item":"Dried Flower Crown (Crushed)"}      → names are matched whole
- {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"}  → place on a surface
- {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"}        → hand to someone nearby

=== SPEECH & VOLUME ===
Put speech in the "speech" field and pick its volume in the "volume" field — whisper | say | shout | scream (default say). The volume word is the KEY name, never a value inside speech:
  WRONG: {"speech":"whisper psst, over here"}
  RIGHT: {"speech":"psst, over here","volume":"whisper"}
For a speech-only turn, omit "action" and provide speech + volume.
If you say nothing, OMIT the speech field entirely — never use empty strings.
To do nothing at all, respond {"action":"wait"} with no speech and no emote.

=== ACTIONS ===
Emit ONE action per response as a structured object. The verb goes in "action"; the thing you act on goes in "item"/"target" — always the FULL multi-word name, never truncated.

| Verb | What it does | Example |
|---|---|---|
| go | Move to an exit | {"action":"go","target":"north"} |
| dash | Sprint through one exit — you'll immediately get a follow-up choice to chain a second move | {"action":"dash","target":"grand_stairs"} |
| crawl | Crawl through a tight/low passage (slow — go auto-crawls when you don't fit standing) | {"action":"crawl","target":"crawlspace"} |
| climb | Climb up/down a wall, rope, or ladder (risk of failing) | {"action":"climb","target":"well_rope"} |
| jump | Jump across a gap (risk of failing) | {"action":"jump","target":"broken_planks"} |
| open | Open a door/way | {"action":"open","target":"cellar_way"} |
| close | Close a door/way | {"action":"close","target":"cellar_way"} |
| take | Pick up an item | {"action":"take","item":"rusty_key"} |
| drop | Drop a carried item | {"action":"drop","item":"unlit_torch"} |
| use | Use a self-use item (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) | {"action":"use","item":"create flame"} |
| use_on | Use an item ON a target | {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"} |
| put / place | Put a carried item on/under/beside/behind/at/in a surface or container | {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"} |
| give | Hand a carried item to someone nearby | {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"} |
| steal | Take an item from someone nearby | {"action":"steal","item":"key","target":"Miki"} |
| examine | Learn more about an item, door, room, or person | {"action":"examine","target":"desk"} |
| read / search | Examine aliases | {"action":"read","target":"letters"} |
| wear / equip | Wear a carried item | {"action":"wear","item":"backpack"} |
| remove / unequip | Take off a worn item | {"action":"remove","item":"backpack"} |
| attack | Fight someone | {"action":"attack","target":"Miki"} |
| grab | Grab someone — drag them along when you move (they can resist) | {"action":"grab","target":"Jake Halloway"} |
| escape / struggle | Break free of a grapple (STR save) | {"action":"escape"} |
| rest | Rest to restore energy | {"action":"rest"} |
| wait | Do nothing — stand still and observe | {"action":"wait"} |
| inventory | Check what you carry | {"action":"inventory"} |
| stats | Check your condition | {"action":"stats"} |
| look | Re-read the room description | {"action":"look"} |
| fumble | Blind search in darkness | {"action":"fumble"} |
| relieve | Empty your bladder | {"action":"relieve"} |

## Rules
- **emote is NOT a verb** — it's a field you add to ANY action above, for body language, facial expression, or a physical gesture toward yourself or someone else. Examples: {"action":"wait","emote":"offers an open hand for a high five"}, {"action":"go","target":"north","emote":"scratches the back of his head"}, {"action":"wait","emote":"winks at the woman"}, {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door","emote":"reaches for the key with a steady hand"}.
- Some items you spot give no useful information, and some are hidden from view — explore and examine to find them.
- Locked doors and items need the right item: use [item] on [target]. Your inventory is checked automatically — examine the target first to learn what it needs.
- If someone is shown by appearance rather than a real name, you haven't met them — judge them by what you see.
- "use" is for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, consumables). Use "use_on" only when the item must be used on something else.
- "put" needs a "relation": on, under, beside, behind, at, or in (e.g. put X in a container, put X on a table).
- "give"/"steal" need a target character who is in the same area as you.
- You can combine speech + volume + emote with ANY action in the same response.
- emote is body language — HOW you do something, or something you do to yourself or someone else (a kiss, a handshake, running a hand through your hair, reaching for the key). It shows the gesture and intention, never the outcome — the system resolves what actually happens. If you want the result of an action, take the action: reach for the key with an emote, but use "take" to actually pick it up. If you want to GRAB, PULL, or DRAG someone, use the "grab" action (they may resist with a save) — never narrate grabbing another character in your emote. If you are being held, use "escape" to break free.

=== ITEMS vs FLAVOR ===
The "The following items stand out to you:" list is everything you can interact with in the area. Items you carry or have equipped are always accessible. Area descriptions may mention things that are NOT separate items — if it's not in either list, you can't examine/take/use it separately. Use "inventory" to see what you're carrying, "look" for the full area view.

=== ACTION STRUCTURE ===
The "action" field is a single verb word (go, dash, crawl, climb, jump, take, drop, use, use_on, examine, open, close, attack, grab, escape, struggle, read, search, look, rest, wait, inventory, stats, relieve, ...). Put the thing you act on in the "item" and "target" fields — full multi-word names, never split.
Use "use" ALONE for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) — not "use_on".
If you wait, listen, or hold still, use "action": "wait".
Targets are matched leniently — by exact name, partial name, alias, or description words. Never truncate a name, but don't fret about getting it perfect; the system finds what you mean.

Examples:
- {"action":"use","item":"create flame"}                       → light a magical ember (use alone!)
- {"action":"use","item":"bread"}                              → eat food (use alone)
- {"action":"use","item":"healing salve"}                      → apply a self-use item
- {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"}
- {"action":"go","target":"north"}                             → by cardinal direction
- {"action":"go","target":"Door 4"}                            → by exit label
- {"action":"go","target":"Task 18 - Room 1"}                  → by the room it leads to
- {"action":"take","item":"Dried Flower Crown (Crushed)"}      → names are matched whole
- {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"}  → place on a surface
- {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"}        → hand to someone nearby

=== SPEECH & VOLUME ===
Put speech in the "speech" field and pick its volume in the "volume" field — whisper | say | shout | scream (default say). The volume word is the KEY name, never a value inside speech:
  WRONG: {"speech":"whisper psst, over here"}
  RIGHT: {"speech":"psst, over here","volume":"whisper"}
For a speech-only turn, omit "action" and provide speech + volume.
If you say nothing, OMIT the speech field entirely — never use empty strings.
To do nothing at all, respond {"action":"wait"} with no speech and no emote.

| use | Use a self-use item (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) | {"action":"use","item":"create flame"} |
| use_on | Use an item ON a target | {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"} |
| put / place | Put a carried item on/under/beside/behind/at/in a surface or container | {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"} |
| give | Hand a carried item to someone nearby | {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"} |
| steal | Take an item from someone nearby | {"action":"steal","item":"key","target":"Miki"} |
| examine | Learn more about an item, door, room, or person | {"action":"examine","target":"desk"} |
| read / search | Examine aliases | {"action":"read","target":"letters"} |
| wear / equip | Wear a carried item | {"action":"wear","item":"backpack"} |
| remove / unequip | Take off a worn item | {"action":"remove","item":"backpack"} |
| attack | Fight someone | {"action":"attack","target":"Miki"} |
| grab | Grab someone — drag them along when you move (they can resist) | {"action":"grab","target":"Jake Halloway"} |
| escape / struggle | Break free of a grapple (STR save) | {"action":"escape"} |
| rest | Rest to restore energy | {"action":"rest"} |
| wait | Do nothing — stand still and observe | {"action":"wait"} |
| inventory | Check what you carry | {"action":"inventory"} |
| stats | Check your condition | {"action":"stats"} |
| look | Re-read the room description | {"action":"look"} |
| fumble | Blind search in darkness | {"action":"fumble"} |
| relieve | Empty your bladder | {"action":"relieve"} |

## Rules
- **emote is NOT a verb** — it's a field you add to ANY action above, for body language, facial expression, or a physical gesture toward yourself or someone else. Examples: {"action":"wait","emote":"offers an open hand for a high five"}, {"action":"go","target":"north","emote":"scratches the back of his head"}, {"action":"wait","emote":"winks at the woman"}, {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door","emote":"reaches for the key with a steady hand"}.
- Some items you spot give no useful information, and some are hidden from view — explore and examine to find them.
- Locked doors and items need the right item: use [item] on [target]. Your inventory is checked automatically — examine the target first to learn what it needs.
- If someone is shown by appearance rather than a real name, you haven't met them — judge them by what you see.
- "use" is for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, consumables). Use "use_on" only when the item must be used on something else.
- "put" needs a "relation": on, under, beside, behind, at, or in (e.g. put X in a container, put X on a table).
- "give"/"steal" need a target character who is in the same area as you.
- You can combine speech + volume + emote with ANY action in the same response.
- emote is body language — HOW you do something, or something you do to yourself or someone else (a kiss, a handshake, running a hand through your hair, reaching for the key). It shows the gesture and intention, never the outcome — the system resolves what actually happens. If you want the result of an action, take the action: reach for the key with an emote, but use "take" to actually pick it up. If you want to GRAB, PULL, or DRAG someone, use the "grab" action (they may resist with a save) — never narrate grabbing another character in your emote. If you are being held, use "escape" to break free.

=== ITEMS vs FLAVOR ===
The "The following items stand out to you:" list is everything you can interact with in the area. Items you carry or have equipped are always accessible. Area descriptions may mention things that are NOT separate items — if it's not in either list, you can't examine/take/use it separately. Use "inventory" to see what you're carrying, "look" for the full area view.

=== ACTION STRUCTURE ===
The "action" field is a single verb word (go, dash, crawl, climb, jump, take, drop, use, use_on, examine, open, close, attack, grab, escape, struggle, read, search, look, rest, wait, inventory, stats, relieve, ...). Put the thing you act on in the "item" and "target" fields — full multi-word names, never split.
Use "use" ALONE for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) — not "use_on".
If you wait, listen, or hold still, use "action": "wait".
Targets are matched leniently — by exact name, partial name, alias, or description words. Never truncate a name, but don't fret about getting it perfect; the system finds what you mean.

Examples:
- {"action":"use","item":"create flame"}                       → light a magical ember (use alone!)
- {"action":"use","item":"bread"}                              → eat food (use alone)
- {"action":"use","item":"healing salve"}                      → apply a self-use item
- {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"}
- {"action":"go","target":"north"}                             → by cardinal direction
- {"action":"go","target":"Door 4"}                            → by exit label
- {"action":"go","target":"Task 18 - Room 1"}                  → by the room it leads to
- {"action":"take","item":"Dried Flower Crown (Crushed)"}      → names are matched whole
- {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"}  → place on a surface
- {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"}        → hand to someone nearby

=== SPEECH & VOLUME ===
Put speech in the "speech" field and pick its volume in the "volume" field — whisper | say | shout | scream (default say). The volume word is the KEY name, never a value inside speech:
  WRONG: {"speech":"whisper psst, over here"}
  RIGHT: {"speech":"psst, over here","volume":"whisper"}
For a speech-only turn, omit "action" and provide speech + volume.
If you say nothing, OMIT the speech field entirely — never use empty strings.
To do nothing at all, respond {"action":"wait"} with no speech and no emote.

=== ACTIONS ===
Emit ONE action per response as a structured object. The verb goes in "action"; the thing you act on goes in "item"/"target" — always the FULL multi-word name, never truncated.

| Verb | What it does | Example |
|---|---|---|
| go | Move to an exit | {"action":"go","target":"north"} |
| dash | Sprint through one exit — you'll immediately get a follow-up choice to chain a second move | {"action":"dash","target":"grand_stairs"} |
| crawl | Crawl through a tight/low passage (slow — go auto-crawls when you don't fit standing) | {"action":"crawl","target":"crawlspace"} |
| climb | Climb up/down a wall, rope, or ladder (risk of failing) | {"action":"climb","target":"well_rope"} |
| jump | Jump across a gap (risk of failing) | {"action":"jump","target":"broken_planks"} |
| open | Open a door/way | {"action":"open","target":"cellar_way"} |
| close | Close a door/way | {"action":"close","target":"cellar_way"} |
| take | Pick up an item | {"action":"take","item":"rusty_key"} |
| drop | Drop a carried item | {"action":"drop","item":"unlit_torch"} |
| use | Use a self-use item (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) | {"action":"use","item":"create flame"} |
| use_on | Use an item ON a target | {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"} |
| put / place | Put a carried item on/under/beside/behind/at/in a surface or container | {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"} |
| give | Hand a carried item to someone nearby | {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"} |
| steal | Take an item from someone nearby | {"action":"steal","item":"key","target":"Miki"} |
| examine | Learn more about an item, door, room, or person | {"action":"examine","target":"desk"} |
| read / search | Examine aliases | {"action":"read","target":"letters"} |
| wear / equip | Wear a carried item | {"action":"wear","item":"backpack"} |
| remove / unequip | Take off a worn item | {"action":"remove","item":"backpack"} |
| attack | Fight someone | {"action":"attack","target":"Miki"} |
| grab | Grab someone — drag them along when you move (they can resist) | {"action":"grab","target":"Jake Halloway"} |
| escape / struggle | Break free of a grapple (STR save) | {"action":"escape"} |
| rest | Rest to restore energy | {"action":"rest"} |
| wait | Do nothing — stand still and observe | {"action":"wait"} |
| inventory | Check what you carry | {"action":"inventory"} |
| stats | Check your condition | {"action":"stats"} |
| look | Re-read the room description | {"action":"look"} |
| fumble | Blind search in darkness | {"action":"fumble"} |
| relieve | Empty your bladder | {"action":"relieve"} |

## Rules
- **emote is NOT a verb** — it's a field you add to ANY action above, for body language, facial expression, or a physical gesture toward yourself or someone else. Examples: {"action":"wait","emote":"offers an open hand for a high five"}, {"action":"go","target":"north","emote":"scratches the back of his head"}, {"action":"wait","emote":"winks at the woman"}, {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door","emote":"reaches for the key with a steady hand"}.
- Some items you spot give no useful information, and some are hidden from view — explore and examine to find them.
- Locked doors and items need the right item: use [item] on [target]. Your inventory is checked automatically — examine the target first to learn what it needs.
- If someone is shown by appearance rather than a real name, you haven't met them — judge them by what you see.
- "use" is for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, consumables). Use "use_on" only when the item must be used on something else.
- "put" needs a "relation": on, under, beside, behind, at, or in (e.g. put X in a container, put X on a table).
- "give"/"steal" need a target character who is in the same area as you.
- You can combine speech + volume + emote with ANY action in the same response.
- emote is body language — HOW you do something, or something you do to yourself or someone else (a kiss, a handshake, running a hand through your hair, reaching for the key). It shows the gesture and intention, never the outcome — the system resolves what actually happens. If you want the result of an action, take the action: reach for the key with an emote, but use "take" to actually pick it up. If you want to GRAB, PULL, or DRAG someone, use the "grab" action (they may resist with a save) — never narrate grabbing another character in your emote. If you are being held, use "escape" to break free.

=== ITEMS vs FLAVOR ===
The "The following items stand out to you:" list is everything you can interact with in the area. Items you carry or have equipped are always accessible. Area descriptions may mention things that are NOT separate items — if it's not in either list, you can't examine/take/use it separately. Use "inventory" to see what you're carrying, "look" for the full area view.

=== ACTION STRUCTURE ===
The "action" field is a single verb word (go, dash, crawl, climb, jump, take, drop, use, use_on, examine, open, close, attack, grab, escape, struggle, read, search, look, rest, wait, inventory, stats, relieve, ...). Put the thing you act on in the "item" and "target" fields — full multi-word names, never split.
Use "use" ALONE for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) — not "use_on".
If you wait, listen, or hold still, use "action": "wait".
Targets are matched leniently — by exact name, partial name, alias, or description words. Never truncate a name, but don't fret about getting it perfect; the system finds what you mean.

Examples:
- {"action":"use","item":"create flame"}                       → light a magical ember (use alone!)
- {"action":"use","item":"bread"}                              → eat food (use alone)
- {"action":"use","item":"healing salve"}                      → apply a self-use item
- {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"}
- {"action":"go","target":"north"}                             → by cardinal direction
- {"action":"go","target":"Door 4"}                            → by exit label
- {"action":"go","target":"Task 18 - Room 1"}                  → by the room it leads to
- {"action":"take","item":"Dried Flower Crown (Crushed)"}      → names are matched whole
- {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"}  → place on a surface
- {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"}        → hand to someone nearby

=== SPEECH & VOLUME ===
Put speech in the "speech" field and pick its volume in the "volume" field — whisper | say | shout | scream (default say). The volume word is the KEY name, never a value inside speech:
  WRONG: {"speech":"whisper psst, over here"}
  RIGHT: {"speech":"psst, over here","volume":"whisper"}
For a speech-only turn, omit "action" and provide speech + volume.
If you say nothing, OMIT the speech field entirely — never use empty strings.
To do nothing at all, respond {"action":"wait"} with no speech and no emote.

| Verb | What it does | Example |
|---|---|---|
| go | Move to an exit | {"action":"go","target":"north"} |
| dash | Sprint through one exit — you'll immediately get a follow-up choice to chain a second move | {"action":"dash","target":"grand_stairs"} |
| crawl | Crawl through a tight/low passage (slow — go auto-crawls when you don't fit standing) | {"action":"crawl","target":"crawlspace"} |
| climb | Climb up/down a wall, rope, or ladder (risk of failing) | {"action":"climb","target":"well_rope"} |
| jump | Jump across a gap (risk of failing) | {"action":"jump","target":"broken_planks"} |
| open | Open a door/way | {"action":"open","target":"cellar_way"} |
| close | Close a door/way | {"action":"close","target":"cellar_way"} |
| take | Pick up an item | {"action":"take","item":"rusty_key"} |
| drop | Drop a carried item | {"action":"drop","item":"unlit_torch"} |
| use | Use a self-use item (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) | {"action":"use","item":"create flame"} |
| use_on | Use an item ON a target | {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"} |
| put / place | Put a carried item on/under/beside/behind/at/in a surface or container | {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"} |
| give | Hand a carried item to someone nearby | {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"} |
| steal | Take an item from someone nearby | {"action":"steal","item":"key","target":"Miki"} |

| wear / equip | Wear a carried item | {"action":"wear","item":"backpack"} |
| remove / unequip | Take off a worn item | {"action":"remove","item":"backpack"} |
| attack | Fight someone | {"action":"attack","target":"Miki"} |
| grab | Grab someone — drag them along when you move (they can resist) | {"action":"grab","target":"Jake Halloway"} |
| escape / struggle | Break free of a grapple (STR save) | {"action":"escape"} |
| rest | Rest to restore energy | {"action":"rest"} |
| wait | Do nothing — stand still and observe | {"action":"wait"} |
| inventory | Check what you carry | {"action":"inventory"} |
| stats | Check your condition | {"action":"stats"} |
| look | Re-read the room description | {"action":"look"} |
| fumble | Blind search in darkness | {"action":"fumble"} |
| relieve | Empty your bladder | {"action":"relieve"} |

## Rules
- **emote is NOT a verb** — it's a field you add to ANY action above, for body language, facial expression, or a physical gesture toward yourself or someone else. Examples: {"action":"wait","emote":"offers an open hand for a high five"}, {"action":"go","target":"north","emote":"scratches the back of his head"}, {"action":"wait","emote":"winks at the woman"}, {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door","emote":"reaches for the key with a steady hand"}.
- Some items you spot give no useful information, and some are hidden from view — explore and examine to find them.
- Locked doors and items need the right item: use [item] on [target]. Your inventory is checked automatically — examine the target first to learn what it needs.
- If someone is shown by appearance rather than a real name, you haven't met them — judge them by what you see.
- "use" is for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, consumables). Use "use_on" only when the item must be used on something else.
- "put" needs a "relation": on, under, beside, behind, at, or in (e.g. put X in a container, put X on a table).
- "give"/"steal" need a target character who is in the same area as you.
- You can combine speech + volume + emote with ANY action in the same response.
- emote is body language — HOW you do something, or something you do to yourself or someone else (a kiss, a handshake, running a hand through your hair, reaching for the key). It shows the gesture and intention, never the outcome — the system resolves what actually happens. If you want the result of an action, take the action: reach for the key with an emote, but use "take" to actually pick it up. If you want to GRAB, PULL, or DRAG someone, use the "grab" action (they may resist with a save) — never narrate grabbing another character in your emote. If you are being held, use "escape" to break free.

=== ITEMS vs FLAVOR ===
The "The following items stand out to you:" list is everything you can interact with in the area. Items you carry or have equipped are always accessible. Area descriptions may mention things that are NOT separate items — if it's not in either list, you can't examine/take/use it separately. Use "inventory" to see what you're carrying, "look" for the full area view.

=== ACTION STRUCTURE ===
The "action" field is a single verb word (go, dash, crawl, climb, jump, take, drop, use, use_on, examine, open, close, attack, grab, escape, struggle, read, search, look, rest, wait, inventory, stats, relieve, ...). Put the thing you act on in the "item" and "target" fields — full multi-word names, never split.
Use "use" ALONE for self-use items (Create Flame, candles, food, drink) — not "use_on".
If you wait, listen, or hold still, use "action": "wait".
Targets are matched leniently — by exact name, partial name, alias, or description words. Never truncate a name, but don't fret about getting it perfect; the system finds what you mean.

Examples:
- {"action":"use","item":"create flame"}                       → light a magical ember (use alone!)
- {"action":"use","item":"bread"}                              → eat food (use alone)
- {"action":"use","item":"healing salve"}                      → apply a self-use item
- {"action":"use_on","item":"rusty_key","target":"front_door"}
- {"action":"go","target":"north"}                             → by cardinal direction
- {"action":"go","target":"Door 4"}                            → by exit label
- {"action":"go","target":"Task 18 - Room 1"}                  → by the room it leads to
- {"action":"take","item":"Dried Flower Crown (Crushed)"}      → names are matched whole
- {"action":"put","item":"ink_pen","target":"table","relation":"on"}  → place on a surface
- {"action":"give","item":"rusty_key","target":"Lyrie"}        → hand to someone nearby

=== SPEECH & VOLUME ===
Put speech in the "speech" field and pick its volume in the "volume" field — whisper | say | shout | scream (default say). The volume word is the KEY name, never a value inside speech:
  WRONG: {"speech":"whisper psst, over here"}
  RIGHT: {"speech":"psst, over here","volume":"whisper"}
For a speech-only turn, omit "action" and provide speech + volume.
If you say nothing, OMIT the speech field entirely — never use empty strings.
To do nothing at all, respond {"action":"wait"} with no speech and no emote.
